name: WF-362 — Seller Response Monitoring → Timeout / Seller Response Event Controller

parameters.jsCode: const i=$input.first().json||{}; const now=new Date().toISOString(); const dealId=i.deal_id||i.dealId; const leadId=i.lead_id||i.leadId; const propertyId=i.property_id||i.propertyId; const providerMessageId=i.provider_message_id||i.providerMessageId; const monitoringKey=i.monitoring_idempotency_key||i.idempotency_key; const dnc=Boolean(i.dnc||i.do_not_contact); const blockers=Array.isArray(i.blockers)?i.blockers:[]; const attempts=Number(i.attempts||0); const maxAttempts=Number(i.max_attempts||5); const responseText=i.seller_response||i.inbound_message||i.response_text||''; const status=String(i.monitoring_status||i.status||'').toLowerCase(); const dueAt=i.response_due_at||i.timeout_at; let route='waiting'; let reason='response_not_due'; if(dnc){route='human_control';reason='dnc';} else if(blockers.length){route='human_control';reason='blocker';} else if(!dealId||!leadId||!propertyId||!providerMessageId){route='reconciliation';reason='missing_identity';} else if(responseText){route='seller_response';reason='seller_response_received';} else if(['failed','bounced','rejected','undeliverable'].includes(status)){route='retry_reengagement';reason='delivery_failed';} else if(i.timeout_due===true || (dueAt && new Date(dueAt).getTime()<=Date.now())){route='followup_decision';reason='response_timeout';} else if(attempts>=maxAttempts){route='human_control';reason='max_attempts';} const key=(monitoringKey||[dealId,leadId,providerMessageId].filter(Boolean).join(':'))+':event:'+reason; return [{json:{...i,workflow_id:'WF-362',status:'accepted',route,reason,deal_id:dealId,lead_id:leadId,property_id:propertyId,provider_message_id:providerMessageId,monitoring_idempotency_key:monitoringKey,response_due_at:dueAt,event_idempotency_key:key,processed_at:now,crm_activity:{type:'seller_response_monitoring_event',workflow_id:'WF-362',route,reason,provider_message_id:providerMessageId,response_received:Boolean(responseText),response_due_at:dueAt}}}];

meta.purpose: Evaluate seller response monitoring events and route seller responses, timeouts, delivery recovery, or human control
